verdict.rationale: Hatchet does not document a first-party natural-language interface for operating the platform. The closest evidence is the 'Hatchet Agent Tools' MCP cookbook, which exposes workflows and tasks as tools that agent frameworks like the Claude Agent SDK and OpenAI Agents SDK can invoke, so a user could trigger runs through an agent. An llms.txt file also lets agents read the docs. Missing for 10: a native or official natural-language control surface for managing workflows, workers, schedules and deployments; a first-party MCP server for operating the control plane itself (the cookbook covers user-defined workflows only); and any hands-on or independent corroboration.
